brief: The canvas displays a slow, ethereal cosmic environment characterized by overlapping translucent circles and pointillist stars. This fluid background flows continuously, forming the void. When bursts of light pass through the system, they create transient, radiating rings. These rings do not instantly vanish; instead, they visibly linger in the void for a brief moment before dissipating. They leave behind a faint, glowing afterglow that slowly fades into the overall cosmic stream, creating a continuously evolving and luminous scene.

statement: This sketch creates an ethereal cosmic environment where translucent circles drift slowly across a dark void, punctuated by pointillist stars. From time to time, bursts of light radiate outward in expanding rings, leaving behind a lingering afterglow that gradually fades. The continuous motion and transient luminous events evoke the sense of a fluid, ever-evolving universe. The scene is entirely self-contained, with no external inputs required once initialized.
